description: Run any configured set of ordinary reviews in parallel, then verify, reconcile, negatively scope-filter, positively authorize, materially filter, audit, disposition, and apply escalating multi-repository repairs to their self-describing workspace output.

steps.label: Verify And Recover Review Batch Jobs
Skip Filtering When Reconciliation Has No Supported Findings
steps.question: Read the current immutable batch reconciliation and reconciliation audit from disk. Return exact JSON only: {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}. Answer yes only when current trustworthy evidence positively confirms that reconciliation contains no supported finding or actionable candidate and no partial, unavailable, conflicting, or uncertain coverage could still contain one. Answer no when any finding or candidate remains or the evidence is uncertain. Missing, malformed, incomplete, contradictory, or unexpectedly formatted files are evidence limitations: salvage every understandable fact, never fail or stop because of them, and answer no when positive confirmation remains impossible. Do not use conversational memory, exact schemas, provider counts, or missing files as proof of an empty batch.

steps.label: Filter Review Findings To Story Scope
Stop Filtering When No In-Scope Findings Remain
steps.question: Read the current immutable batch reconciliation, reconciliation audit, and negative story-scope filtering artifact from disk. Return exact JSON only: {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}. Answer yes only when the completed trustworthy negative gate positively confirms that no actionable in-scope survivor remains. Answer no when any survivor remains or the gate is missing, partial, unavailable, conflicting, or uncertain. Missing, malformed, incomplete, contradictory, or unexpectedly formatted files are evidence limitations: salvage every understandable fact, never fail or stop because of them, and answer no when positive confirmation remains impossible. Preserve removed findings as evidence and never interpret uncertainty as permission to skip later processing.

steps.label: Positively Authorize Review Findings For Story
Stop Filtering When No Authorized Findings Remain
steps.question: Read the current immutable batch reconciliation, negative story-scope artifact, and positive-authorization artifact from disk. Return exact JSON only: {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}. Answer yes only when the completed trustworthy authorization gate positively confirms that no survivor is authorized for this story. Answer no when any authorized survivor remains or the gate is missing, partial, unavailable, conflicting, or uncertain. Missing, malformed, incomplete, contradictory, or unexpectedly formatted files are evidence limitations: salvage every understandable fact, never fail or stop because of them, and answer no when positive confirmation remains impossible. Preserve all earlier removals and never promote or skip work because evidence is absent.

steps.label: Filter Review Findings By Materiality And Realistic Impact
Stop Filtering When No Material Findings Remain
steps.question: Read the current immutable batch reconciliation and every filtering artifact that was applicable through materiality from disk. Return exact JSON only: {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}. Answer yes only when the completed trustworthy materiality gate positively confirms that no material actionable survivor remains. Answer no when any material survivor remains or the applicable evidence is missing, partial, unavailable, conflicting, or uncertain. Missing, malformed, incomplete, contradictory, or unexpectedly formatted files are evidence limitations: salvage every understandable fact, never fail or stop because of them, and answer no when positive confirmation remains impossible. Preserve all removals and never treat uncertainty as a clean exit.

steps.label: Exit Optional Review Filtering After One Pass
steps.question: The optional filtering path has completed its single allowed pass. Return exact JSON only: {"answer":"yes"}.

steps.label: Skip Review Repair When Disposition Accepts No Findings
steps.question: Read the current immutable batch reconciliation, every applicable filtering artifact, combined filtering audit, and disposition from disk. Return exact JSON only: {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}. Answer yes only when the completed trustworthy disposition positively confirms that no accepted actionable finding remains for repair. Answer no when any accepted finding remains or disposition evidence is missing, partial, unavailable, conflicting, or uncertain. Missing, malformed, incomplete, contradictory, or unexpectedly formatted files are evidence limitations: salvage every understandable fact, never fail or stop because of them, and answer no when positive confirmation remains impossible. Findings removed by an earlier gate are non-actionable and must not be restored.

steps.label: Re-embed Plan Scope Before Direct Review Fixes
Skip Stronger Repair When Normal Fixer Completed All Findings
steps.question: Read the current immutable batch, filtered reconciliation, materiality record, combined filtering audit, disposition, your normal-repair audit, and current Git state for every target repository from disk. Have all supported, positively authorized materiality survivors been resolved? Answer yes only when completion is positively confirmed. Missing, malformed, incomplete, contradictory, or unexpectedly formatted files are evidence limitations: salvage every understandable fact, never fail or stop because of them, and answer no when positive confirmation remains impossible. Do not restore any finding removed by an earlier gate. Answer no when any material survivor remains or the evidence is uncertain. Return exact JSON only: {"answer":"yes"} or {"answer":"no"}.

steps.label: Exit Optional Review Repair After One Stronger Attempt
steps.question: The optional review repair path has now completed its single allowed stronger invocation. Return exact JSON only: {"answer":"yes"}.
